items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Ink Williams, he sent Ink to take me out one day and tried to show me all the interesting places in Chicago to museums and things like that.

ctx.x: S—no, S-C-U-L-L. Oh, S-C-U-L-L. Skull. Skull. Yeah. He said S-K-U-L. Yes. S-T-U-L-L. But he's a plural player. And at the time, Ink Williams was pro— Oh, yes, I know him. Very popular. And Ink Williams, he sent Ink to take me out one day and tried to show me all the interesting places in Chicago to museums and things like that. Yes. And show me the different schools and the colleges. And he said how my brother had pulled up on his boots. He said, your brother really educated himself by pulling up on his…
